name: City Council - Special Meeting - Oct 15, 2026
agenda_text:
Agenda
BURBANK CITY COUNCIL
SPECIAL MEETING
THURSDAY, OCTOBER 15, 2026
11:00 a.m. – Los Angeles Marriott Burbank Airport
Convention Center
2500 N. Hollywood Way
NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special City Council Meeting will be held at the LOS ANGELES MARRIOTT BURBANK AIRPORT CONVENTION CENTER – 2500 N. HOLLYWOOD WAY , on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 11:00 a.m., to discuss matters on the attached agenda.
Members of the public have the option to participate in the meeting in-person during Special Meeting Public Comment. They may also submit their written comments regarding City business using the eComment feature on the City website.
For information regarding ADA accommodations, please contact the ADA Coordinator at (818) 238-5051. 24-hour notice is required is required for requests for accommodation.
Interpretation Requests :
If you would like to participate in Public Comments and require an interpreter, please telephone the City Clerk's Office at (818) 238-5851 at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting.
Si desea participar en los comentarios públicos y necesita un intérprete, por favor llame a la Oficina de la Secretaria Municipal al (818) 238-5851 al menos 24 horas antes de la reunión.
Public Comment Options :
To speak during Special Meeting Public Comment, members of the public may speak in-person in the Los Angeles Marriott Burbank Airport Convention Center . Speaker time limits will be determined by the Presiding Officer, depending on how many public comment cards are received at the commencement of the public comment period (as shown below). Additional public comment cards will not be accepted once the public comment period commences.
1 – 20 Total Speakers – 3 minutes each
21 – 39 Total Speakers – 2 minutes each
40+ Total Speakers – 1 minute each
Written public comment may be submitted via eComment, available on the City website ( www.burbankca.gov/web/city-clerks-office/ecomment ) from the time the agenda is posted until 10:00 a.m. the day of the meeting. eComments will be distributed to the City Council in advance of the meeting.
The Presiding Officer has the discretion to reduce speaking time for each speaker, depending on the number of speakers, in order to ensure that City business can be completed.
Public Disclosure :
Please be advised that any communication submitted to the City of Burbank, its officials, staff or City consultants, may be considered a public record under the Brown Act and California Public Records Act. This means that any information contained in the communication, including personal information, may be subject to public disclosure. The City reserves the right to disclose such information in accordance with the law.
This agenda contains a summary of each item of business which the City Council may discuss or act on at this meeting. The agenda packet consisting of the staff reports and all other documentation relating to each item on this agenda will be posted on the City's website at www.burbankca.gov. Any writings or documents provided to the City Council regarding any item on this agenda subsequent to distribution of the agenda packet will be posted on the City's website at www.burbankca.gov. If you have a question about any matter on the agenda, please call the Office of the City Clerk at (818) 238-5851. For information regarding ADA accommodations, please contact the ADA Coordinator at (818) 238-5051. 24-hour notice is required is required for requests for accommodation.
A. Call to Order (Lobby of Convention Center) :
B. Roll Call :
C. Special Meeting Public Comment : (On Special Meeting items only.) To comment in person, a TAN Public Comment Card must be completed and presented to the City Clerk prior to the comment period.
D. State of the City Address (Ballroom)
E. Adjournment : To Tuesday, October 20, 2026, for a Special Meeting at Burbank Water and Power in the Electric Services Building and Courtyard – 320 North Lake Street.
